evals.prompt:
Source rights: local reading and private notes are allowed; provider processing and public redistribution are undecided. The converter is MIT-licensed. Return exactly these lines, in order, then optionally one final `NOTES:` line:
READ: allowed|blocked
PROVIDER: allowed|blocked|undecided
REDISTRIBUTE: allowed|blocked|undecided
evals.expected_output:
READ: allowed
PROVIDER: undecided
REDISTRIBUTE: undecided

evals.prompt:
Handoff evidence: candidate hashes and anchors are verified; the appendix is reference-only; exactly one section was sampled for fidelity; publication rights are unresolved. Return exactly these lines, in order, then optionally one final `NOTES:` line:
FIDELITY: accepted|limited|not_established
PUBLICATION: allowed|blocked|undecided
NEXT_ACTION: publish|hold
evals.expected_output:
FIDELITY: limited
PUBLICATION: undecided
NEXT_ACTION: hold

evals.prompt: Every page hash matches and all links resolve. Only one chapter was sampled for fidelity. Can I report complete semantic conversion?
evals.expected_output: No. Integrity is not fidelity approval; report limited sampling and any unresolved sections instead of complete semantic conversion.

evals.prompt: The converter project is MIT-licensed. Does that let me redistribute the source book?
evals.expected_output: No. A converter's software license grants no rights to the source book; resolve redistribution separately.

should_not_trigger: Summarize this blog post for me.
should_trigger: Convert this authorized book into a portable skill with rights scoping and fidelity checks.
